discoveries.reason: Released 2026-08-26; open-weight 125B MoE / 6B active with strong agentic coding and tool-use claims. Official Ollama package currently exposes a 105GB 125b-mlx build, which is outside the Legion 31.3GB RAM resource envelope and is not installed. No Builder Olympics or Talos qualification was executed because local availability/resource gate failed.
